subject: Ciências
description_pt: Observar, identificar e registrar os períodos diários (dia e/ou noite) em que o Sol, demais estrelas, Lua e planetas estão visíveis no céu.

components.description_pt: Identificar quais corpos celestes são visíveis durante o dia e a noite
components.description_en: Identify which celestial bodies are visible during daytime and nighttime
components.cc_component_description: Describe observable patterns of stars visible in the night sky

components.description_pt: Registrar os horários do dia em que o Sol, Lua, planetas e estrelas são observáveis no céu
components.description_en: Record the times of day during which the Sun, Moon, planets, and stars are observable in the sky
components.cc_component_description: Observe and record patterns in the apparent position or movement of the sun across the sky

cc_matches.description: Use observations of the sun, moon, and stars to describe patterns that can be predicted.
